Quick HSK 1 quiz 📱

手机 (shǒujī) is made of 手 = hand and 机 = machine. So what is a "hand machine"?

A) a watch
B) a mobile phone
C) a camera

Comment A, B or C 👇 Bonus: you probably say 我的手机 (wǒ de shǒujī) every day. What does it mean?

📤 Send this to someone preparing for the HSK
